_about: Frameflow config for the shorts-director skill (~/Talha_Khan/Claude/skills/shorts-director).
house_rules: Visual identity: Paper Press (warm paper, ink lines, editorial red for danger, blue for AI/good, yellow for light/highlight)
Vertical 1080x1920; captions occupy the bottom third, so the drawing lives in the top two thirds
Brand names as plain words only; no logos
Every number said is shown on screen
Use the news-snapshot template at most once, and only with the source URL from the script's fact ids
Open on a strong visual world, never on a plain title card
_models: 2026-10-25: Opus only for the script draft / storyboard; Sonnet for hooks, judge and fix rounds; 1 fix round (vault Docs/Tokens Per Video.md)
